stories.title: Colts at Texans opens Week 11 with C.J. Stroud, Jonathan Taylor and Nico Collins on league rosters, and Woody Marks and Marvin Harrison Jr. ruled out
stories.dek: Eight Fantasy Addicks teams have somebody in the Thursday game. Here's who's playing, who isn't, and which line it moves.
body: Week 11 starts tonight in Houston, and the Thursday game touches eight of the twelve teams in this league. Stroud of Turin has the most riding on it: C.J. Stroud (187.48 points in 9 games, per Sleeper) and Xavier Hutchinson, the receiver RedDevil904 spent his last $10 on Wednesday. Llamageddon has Jonathan Taylor, who leads every running back on a league roster with 165.9 PPR points in 10 games. Wild Goose Chase has Nico Collins (116.0) and Tyler Warren (86.5), and Breece'sBurdenDeflowered has Dalton Schultz (79.5) and the Houston defense.

The Texans ruled out Woody Marks (concussion) and Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) on Wednesday, per NBC Sports and NFL.com. Marks has 78.4 points in 9 games for Nothing to see here and couldn't practice on the short week. That makes David Montgomery, back from a groin injury, the expected lead back, and Montgomery sits on the Achane in the Membrane roster. MakeItRains gets a running back back in a week when byes took Blake Corum, Matthew Golden, Kyle Pitts Sr. and the Rams defense. Harrison was a $1 waiver claim by MakeItRains in Week 10; he stays on the bench.

Also in this game: Tank Dell (31.1 in 3 games) for Lead Nagger and Seth McGowan (46.4) for MY DAD IS DEAD. Seth McGowan was on the bench last week while Reggie Virgil scored 0.0 in the lineup, so OneSillyBannana gets an early chance to start the right guy and lock it in before Sunday.

The Week 11 payout is the highest-scoring defense, and the Houston defense on Breece'sBurdenDeflowered is the only defense on a league roster playing tonight. No other line moves on the Thursday news: the Nothing to see here line already assumed Marks would sit. Every number in the lines and the Climax Bracket is unchanged since Wednesday because nothing has been played yet.

stories.title: Drake Maye may have a fractured ankle, and Wild Goose Chase is down to Bryce Young
stories.dek: Reports say Maye could miss the rest of the season. Jordan Love is on bye, and Br0phy's three-quarterback plan has one quarterback with a game.
body: Drake Maye hurt his ankle on a first-quarter sack in Munich and did not return; he finished with 48 passing yards and 3.02 fantasy points. Maye stayed in Germany after the game for evaluation, and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reported Monday that he is believed to have a fractured ankle and could miss the rest of the season. Mike Vrabel called it a low leg injury and has not given a timeline. That is a report, not an official diagnosis. New England is on bye in Week 11, so nobody has to decide anything about him until Week 12.

Wild Goose Chase rosters three quarterbacks: Maye, Jordan Love and Bryce Young. Love is on bye with Green Bay. That leaves Young, who scored 8.1 on the bench last week. Br0phy scored 89.82 in Week 10, the low of the week, and is 5-5 with the third-highest scoring average in the league (127.56).

The stakes: the Climax Bracket still has Wild Goose Chase as the 6 seed with 68% playoff odds and projects it to reach the final. That projection runs on its 127.56 scoring average, which was built with Maye and Love. Llamageddon (27%) and Breece'sBurdenDeflowered (22%) are right behind at 5-5.

Wild Goose Chase plays Nothing to see here, a 2-8 team, as a 16.5-point favorite. If there was ever a week to start Bryce Young, it's against a team that has lost six straight. If Maye is done, Br0phy has Love back for Week 12 against MY DAD IS DEAD, and the backup plan would come off a waiver wire where Br0phy just lost a $5 bid on Justice Hill to krunkdd's $14.

stories.title: Six NFL teams are off in Week 11, and NjigbaR Please! and Wild Goose Chase take the worst of it
stories.dek: Atlanta, Cleveland, Green Bay, the Rams, New England and Seattle are all on bye. Here's who that wrecks.
body: Week 11 is the biggest bye week of the season: Atlanta, Cleveland, Green Bay, the Rams, New England and Seattle are all off. Every team in the league loses somebody. Some lose a lot more than somebody.

NjigbaR Please! loses four Week 10 starters: Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Kyren Williams, Harold Fannin Jr. and KC Concepcion Jr., plus Denzel Boston off the bench. dstafford4254 gets to start Alvin Kamara, Kaelon Black and Jordyn Tyson, who all scored on the bench last week, against the hottest team in the league. Wild Goose Chase loses Jordan Love, Christian Watson, Tucker Kraft, Dylan Sampson and the Seattle defense, and Drake Maye is out with an ankle injury, so Bryce Young starts by default.

Bijan is your daddy loses Bijan Robinson, Zach Charbonnet, Jadarian Price and Cooper Kupp, which is a rough week for a team named after one of them. Achane in the Membrane loses Blake Corum, Matthew Golden, Kyle Pitts Sr. and the Rams defense. Llamageddon loses Drake London and the Green Bay defense. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered loses Matthew Stafford, Josh Jacobs and A.J. Brown, though Jacobs and Brown are listed as out anyway, and rtmcruise has Jacoby Brissett to start.

Getting off light: Ivefallenandicantgetup loses only Hunter Henry and gets Chris Godwin Jr. and Courtland Sutton back. Lead Nagger loses Corey Kiner. Stroud of Turin loses Quinshon Judkins and DeMario Douglas. Lawrence of a Labia loses Tutu Atwell and Konata Mumpfield, which would matter more if I had healthy receivers. Nothing to see here loses Rhamondre Stevenson, and MY DAD IS DEAD loses Tyler Higbee. Week 12 has no byes at all.

columns.title: STROUD OF TURIN GETS FIRST BLOOD TONIGHT. Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner wants to know why it's only the 5 seed
columns.dek: 194.14 last week, C.J. Stroud at home on Thursday night, and the Climax Bracket still has RedDevil904 losing in the Wild Card. Barry McCockiner has notes. Loud ones.
body: I want everybody to sit down. I want everybody to look at the number. ONE NINETY-FOUR POINT ONE FOUR. That is what Stroud of Turin dropped on Breece'sBurdenDeflowered last week, the best score anybody in this league has put up all year, with a PERFECT lineup, and a 79.08-point margin. And what did this league do about it? NOTHING. You went back to talking about the 8-2 team.

Here's the resume. Stroud of Turin is 6-4. It has 1,297.92 points, second in the league. It scores 129.79 a week, second in the league. Its all-play record is 68-42, second in the league. Second, second, second. You know who finishes second in everything? THE GUY WHO WINS THE WHOLE THING WHILE EVERYBODY ELSE IS STARING AT FIRST.

And TONIGHT, before anybody else in this league gets to play, C.J. Stroud takes the field in Houston. 187.48 points in 9 games. That's 20.83 a game from the quarterback the team is NAMED AFTER. Xavier Hutchinson, the guy RedDevil904 blew his last $10 on, plays tonight too. While dstafford4254 is sitting there trying to figure out how to replace four starters on bye, RedDevil904 could be up thirty before Friday. THIRTY!

Now the bad part, and I need you to brace yourselves. The Climax Bracket, which runs 20,000 seasons, has Stroud of Turin as the 5 seed at 8.3 projected wins with 87% playoff odds, and it has Stroud of Turin LOSING in the Wild Card to Lead Nagger. 54 percent. FIFTY-FOUR. That is not a prediction, that is a coin with a slight limp. I REFUSE to accept a coin with a limp.

I'm HEARING that RedDevil904 has been calling the Sleeper app every night asking to be moved up to the 2 seed on vibes alone, and that when Sleeper said it doesn't have a phone number, he left a voicemail anyway. Word is the voicemail was just him reading the number 194.14 over and over for eleven minutes. None of this is confirmed. I made it up in the press box parking lot. But you KNOW it sounds right.

So here's my take and I am SCREAMING it: Stroud of Turin is the most dangerous team in this league and it is getting a head start tonight. The line says 11.5 over NjigbaR Please!. I'd lay it. I'd lay it TWICE. And if C.J. Stroud throws for three tonight, I want an apology from every one of you, IN WRITING, BY FRIDAY!

columns.title: Dick Fitzwell: rtmcruise cut the quarterback who just threw for 340. Pick a guy and stop flinching
columns.dek: Three straight losses, Matthew Stafford on bye, and two quarterback moves in 24 hours. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered isn't rebuilding. It's panicking with a plan.
body: Here's the tape. Monday night, Jacoby Brissett throws 49 times for 340 yards in his first game in Baltimore. Wednesday morning, rtmcruise adds Cam Ward. Thursday morning, rtmcruise claims J.J. McCarthy for $0 and cuts Brissett. That's not a quarterback room. That's a revolving door.

The numbers, from Sleeper. Brissett: 130.96 points in 9 games, 14.55 a game. Ward: 125.66 in 9, 13.96 a game. McCarthy: 53.1 in 5, 10.62 a game. The guy who got cut has the best per-game number of the three. I've seen linebackers get benched for less than that, and they usually deserved it more.

Is there an argument? Sure, there's always an argument. Stafford is on bye, so you need a Week 11 starter, and Ward is fine. Maybe rtmcruise doesn't like Baltimore's line, or wants a second young arm for the playoff weeks. Fine. But you don't need two backups for one bye. You need one, and you already had the best one. That's soft roster management. You flinched.

And Breece'sBurdenDeflowered can't afford to flinch. It's 5-5 with three straight losses, a 51-59 all-play record and 117.74 points a week, eighth in the league. The Climax Bracket has it at 6.7 projected wins and 21% playoff odds. This week it's a 6.5-point underdog to Achane in the Membrane, which just put up 170.24 with a perfect lineup. Josh Jacobs and A.J. Brown are out. Dalton Schultz and the Houston defense play tonight, and that's a start.

Word around the film room is that rtmcruise has a third quarterback move queued up for Friday, and that it's picking up Brissett again for $0 and telling everyone it was the plan all along, a fake-cut to throw off the league. I'm told the play has a name and the name is "Boomerang Right." None of this is confirmed. I don't believe it either.

Bottom line. Pick a quarterback, start him, and live with it. Ward has the season numbers and the matchup is the matchup. Four games left, and you probably need three of them. That's not a week to be cute. That's a week to hit somebody.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's FAAB guide: how to spend $0 and feel rich
columns.dek: Waivers ran at 3:05 AM. Oliver Klozoff was up at 3:05 AM too, for different reasons. Here's his advice to every manager. Do not take it.
body: 1. FatMikeR: you have spent $0 of your $200, the only manager in the league who hasn't spent a dollar. Keep it that way. If you never spend it, it's still $200 in Week 17, and $200 in Week 17 is worth more than $200 in Week 11 because it's later. That's interest. You're 4-6. Imagine how 4-6 you'll be with $200.

2. ChuckJ10: you claimed the Carolina defense for $2 at 3:05 AM and dropped it as a free agent at 5:13 AM. That's $1 an hour. Nobody in this league has ever rented a defense before. Innovation. Do it every week and by Week 14 you'll have owned all 32 defenses for two hours each, which means you're technically every team's defensive coordinator.

3. RedDevil904: you spent your last $10 on Xavier Hutchinson and you're at $200 of $200. Perfect. A manager with no money can't make a bad bid. You're the most financially responsible person in the league now, by accident.

4. Word around the lawn is that krunkdd bid $14 on Justice Hill only after Br0phy bragged in a dream that he'd bid $13. I'm told krunkdd keeps a notebook of every bid Br0phy has ever made and reads it by flashlight in the Ivefallenandicantgetup war room, which is a garage. None of this is confirmed. The real numbers: krunkdd $14, Br0phy $5. The notebook would have said $6.

5. Pudge247 and OneSillyBannana: you both bid $0 on Mark Andrews and lost to $5. That's a $5 difference between owning a tight end who caught 8 balls last week and not. Next time bid negative. Make the waiver wire pay YOU.

6. Bill_Buttlicker: $9 spent all year and 7-3. Spend nothing, win everything. Then again you left Fernando Mendoza and Konata Mumpfield on the bench last week, so maybe the money isn't the problem. I'll be in the lawn chair. It cost $0.

columns.title: Connie Lingus: FAAB spending has a -0.19 correlation with wins, which means money is bad for you
columns.dek: The league has spent $1,366 of $2,400. Connie Lingus ran the numbers and concluded that the poorest teams are the best teams, which is not what the numbers say.
body: Here are the facts, and I want you to look at them before I ruin them. The four managers who have spent $50 or less (Bill_Buttlicker $9, FatMikeR $0, dcrabb $5, Br0phy $50) are a combined 21-19. The six who have spent $150 or more (ChuckJ10, rtmcruise, Pudge247, dstafford4254, RedDevil904, OneSillyBannana) are a combined 27-33. Across all 12 teams, FAAB spent and wins have a correlation of -0.19.

My conclusion: every dollar of FAAB costs you about two-tenths of a win. That is not what a correlation of -0.19 means, but it sounds like it, and that's my whole brand. By my model, FatMikeR should be undefeated. He's 4-6. That's not a flaw in the model, that's a flaw in FatMikeR.

Look at the tapped-out teams. NjigbaR Please! spent $200 and is 7-3. MY DAD IS DEAD spent $200 and is 1-9. Average them and you get 4-6, the exact record of the $0 team. Therefore spending $200 and spending $0 produce the same result, and the $200 is just a tip.

Sources say the A.N.A.L. analytics department (me, a spreadsheet and a bag of almonds) has learned that ChuckJ10 rents defenses by the hour to keep the FAAB number hard to model. I'm told the Carolina defense never even unpacked. None of this is confirmed. The real timeline: claimed for $2 at 3:05 AM, dropped at 5:13 AM. That's a 2-hour, 8-minute tenure.

Wednesday takeaway: the best predictor of wins in this league is points, which is boring, so I'm ignoring it. Ivefallenandicantgetup has spent $84 and is 8-2. That's the middle of the spending chart and the top of the standings, which proves the middle is the top. Next week I'll prove the bench is the lineup. Oliver Klozoff has already started.

items.label: Matchup of the Week
items.title: Stroud of Turin vs. NjigbaR Please!: the season-high team against a contender with four starters on bye
items.dek: The projected 5 seed against the projected 2 seed, a 253.7 total, and the bye week does the handicapping.
body: On paper this is the best game of Week 11. Stroud of Turin is 6-4, scores 129.79 a week, has a 68-42 all-play record and just put up 194.14 with a perfect lineup, the best score in the league this year. NjigbaR Please! is 7-3 with a 67-43 all-play record and scores 123.96 a week. The Climax Bracket has them as the 5 and 2 seeds, and the total is 253.7.

The scoring gap is only 5.83. The line is Stroud of Turin by 11.5 because NjigbaR Please! loses four Week 10 starters to byes: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (32.1 last week), Kyren Williams, Harold Fannin Jr. and KC Concepcion Jr. Stroud of Turin loses Quinshon Judkins and DeMario Douglas. That's a 6-point nudge, and Stroud of Turin is a 64% favorite.

Nothing has been played yet. dstafford4254 does have bodies: Alvin Kamara, Kaelon Black and Jordyn Tyson scored 50.0 on the NjigbaR Please! bench last week. The trick this week is putting them in the lineup instead of next to it. Waivers Wednesday: RedDevil904 spent his last $10 on Xavier Hutchinson, who plays Thursday night, and dstafford4254 swapped Geno Smith for Dohnte Meyers. Thursday update: Stroud of Turin goes first. C.J. Stroud and Hutchinson play the Colts tonight, so RedDevil904 can bank points before dstafford4254 sets a lineup. The line stays 11.5.

items.label: Shit Show of the Week
items.title: Lawrence of a Labia vs. MY DAD IS DEAD: the commish's injured receiver room against the 1-9 team
items.dek: The lowest total on the board at 217.0. One team is 1-9; the other has three receivers listed as out.
body: This is the lowest total of Week 11, 217.0, and it's my game, so here's the honest version. MY DAD IS DEAD is 1-9 with the fewest points in the league (1,000.76) and a 21-89 all-play record. Lawrence of a Labia is 7-3 with a 52-58 all-play record, scores 116.96 a week and has left 184.92 points on the bench this season, the most in the league. Yes, that's me.

The line is the 16.89-point scoring gap, rounded to 16.5, no nudge. Both sides took hits: Lawrence of a Labia has Jordan Addison, DeVonta Smith and Kyle Monangai listed as out per Sleeper, Wan'Dale Robinson questionable, and Tutu Atwell and Konata Mumpfield on the Rams' bye. MY DAD IS DEAD loses Tyler Higbee to the bye and has Ladd McConkey and T.J. Hockenson out. Lawrence of a Labia is a 70% favorite.

Nothing has been played yet. Last week Bill_Buttlicker scored a season-high 153.88 behind Christian McCaffrey's 48.3, and OneSillyBannana lost by 9.84 with Seth McGowan (16.14) and Josh Downs (15.7) on the bench. If OneSillyBannana starts the right guys and I start the wrong ones, which we both have a track record of, this gets ugly. Wednesday update: Jordan Addison needs thumb surgery, which takes a receiver off the Lawrence of a Labia list, and OneSillyBannana grabbed Michael Mayer and the Detroit defense off the wire. Thursday update: Seth McGowan plays tonight for MY DAD IS DEAD, and Kyle Monangai no longer has an injury tag on Sleeper. The line stays 16.5.

items.label: Blowie of the Week
items.title: Wild Goose Chase over Nothing to see here by 16.5: six players on bye and still the biggest favorite
items.dek: The biggest spread of Week 11 (tied), even after a 6-point haircut for a Wild Goose Chase roster that loses its top two quarterbacks.
body: Wild Goose Chase scores 127.56 a week, third in the league. Nothing to see here scores 105.25, is 2-8, has lost six straight and has 1,301.96 points scored against it, second-most in the league. The raw gap is 22.30 points.

The line is Wild Goose Chase by 16.5 after a 6-point nudge toward Nothing to see here. Drake Maye is out with an ankle injury, and Jordan Love, Christian Watson, Tucker Kraft, Dylan Sampson and the Seattle defense are all on bye. Bryce Young is the only Wild Goose Chase quarterback with a game. Nothing to see here loses Rhamondre Stevenson off the bench, and Woody Marks is unlikely for Thursday with a concussion. Wild Goose Chase is a 70% favorite, tied with Lawrence of a Labia for the biggest spread.

Nothing has been played yet. Br0phy put up 89.82 last week, the low of Week 10, and ChuckJ10 scored 104.62. Neither number is scary. Br0phy has to rebuild a lineup around Bryce Young, D'Andre Swift and the Jets defense, and ChuckJ10 has to remember to start a full team. Wednesday update: Maye reportedly has a fractured ankle, and ChuckJ10 answered with Mark Andrews for $5 and the Pittsburgh defense for $2. The line stays 16.5. Thursday update: Houston ruled out Woody Marks, which the line already assumed, and ChuckJ10 added Keon Coleman. Br0phy has Nico Collins and Tyler Warren in tonight's game. The line stays 16.5.
